name: zopt_view_rect_clamp_point_to_inclusive_bounds
description: zOpt_ViewRectSection::ClampPointToInclusiveBounds clamps a two-float screen point to a view rectangle's inclusive x/y bounds.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x408430 validates x/y lower-bound and inclusive upper-bound stores against the view-rect fields, with NaN following the original x87 compare path to the upper clamp.
The native smoke checks below-bound, in-bound, above-bound, and NaN point behavior.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x408430 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zOpt/view-rect source-cluster pass.
